title: The Woman Who Organised Her Street
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: After the third flood in two years, one woman on a low-lying street in Accra got tired of waiting for someone else to fix the drainage. She went door to door, got her neighbours to each contribute a small amount, organised a communal cleanup of the gutter, and pushed the local assembly member for a proper drainage repair — and got it. Nobody appointed her to do any of this. She just started, and other people followed. Think about your own street, workplace, or community. What is one climate-related problem you've noticed that nobody has organised a response to yet?
